summary: Push the exact reviewed candidate without force before calling the canonical existing-PR update route with its preserved campaign/chain and previous head. Native PR head and branch ref must match the candidate; machine metadata and unknown FS.GG markers remain protected. Metadata concurrency compares an explicit typed projection of PR/head/base and repository identities, base SHA, exact body/title and relevant state/permission facts. Mergeability, rebaseability, synthetic merge commits and unrelated cache/activity fields remain merge-qualification observations, not metadata-update prerequisites. The strict GitHub PR URL uses validated native repository identity so argument casing does not become a false mismatch. Refusal diagnostics bind the actual deciding initial/prewrite/branch/postwrite read and expose only bounded fixed field labels, types, digests and lengths, never native blobs, private prose or credential stderr. This route still lacks atomic compare-and-swap: permit at most one PATCH, verify exact intended body/title and retained guard on readback, preserve uncertain write/readback failures and lane reservations, and never automatically retry or substitute manual body edits. Offline actual-caller controls qualify the source mechanism; they do not retrospectively establish the cause of an earlier refusal whose internal reads were not retained, or authorize retry of an original operation. Required source eligibility, native delivery, publication and installed acceptance remain separate.
title: Bind canonical PR metadata updates to exact action inputs and candidate order
